import os,json,collections
p='.dip/events/_activity'; c=collections.Counter(); examples=[]
for f in os.scandir(p):
 if not f.is_file(): continue
 try:
  d=json.load(open(f.path)); c.update(d.keys() if isinstance(d,dict) else ['non-object'])
 except Exception: c['unreadable']+=1
print('activity keys:',c.most_common(20))
